author: Claude2 lane, calibration_orchestrator_c2/v003 builder (2026-10-17)
purpose: Classify every terminal outcome of one forward call of driver c2v008 into exactly one class. The orchestrator c2v003 loads THIS file (pinned by sha256 in its config) and evaluates the ordered rules on (driver status, driver reasons, result.route_a_outcome, the route-A checkpoint records, the stage records and the Picard pass history of the call directory); never on status alone. The first matching rule wins; anything unmatched is the default class INFRA. Changes from V001: retarget to the c2v008 status vocabulary (ROUTE_A_NO_FIXED_POINT is its own status since c2v007); CHECK_SCIENCE_V001 C1 (R01 requires the declared Picard bound to be met; new R03), C2 (R10 defaults to NUMERICS_LIMITED; MODEL_INVALID only under a root-declared contraction test), C3 (R30 is a judgment call whenever a bound is declared; per-pass history recorded), C6 (R31 -> INFRA), C10 ('relaxed gas: nonfinite' in R13); new R15 (parallel route-A pool failure) and R39 (stage-binding geometry gap).

classes.VALID: COMPLETED with 12 finite rows AND, when the call declares picard.speed_change_bound_km_s, picard_bound_met is true: cached, final.
classes.MODEL_INVALID: The forward at theta ran its declared procedure to a recorded physical refusal. Cached as an invalid evaluation, final, never relaunched.
classes.NUMERICS_LIMITED: A declared-numerics limitation: the physics answer at theta is not established (root outside a declared bracket, search limit, iteration or pass budget, float resolution). NOT cached; HALT for a root resolve (invalid | retry | retry_with_recovery) with a halt token. Never retried automatically.
classes.INFRA: Everything else (exceptions, ENOSPC, custody/pin/identity mismatch, nonzero exit without a recognized reason, monitor caps, missing receipt, inconsistent records, driver capability gaps). NOT cached; HALT for a root resolve.

default.rule: any (status, reason, route-A outcome) combination not matched by a rule below, including any status not emitted by c2v008

never_resolve_invalid_code_prefixes.reason: CHECK_SCIENCE_V001 C11: monitor caps (wall, RSS, output) correlate with slow convergence (more route-A iterations, more Picard passes), i.e. with the physics; a capability gap is a tooling limit. 'resolve --decision invalid' is refused for these halts; retry (after raising a cap or replacing the driver) is the only resolution.

route_a_evidence.layout: <outdir>/stages/NN_route_a/{request.json (argv --seed), attempt_000/{finish.json | failure.json}, checkpoint/{IDENTITY.json, attempts/<token>.end.json, iteration_NNNN/{START.json, COMPLETED.json, FAILURE.<token>.json}}} (DRV L2214-2241; W and PW write the same layout; the 44 MB attempt result.json is NOT read: result.route_a_outcome carries its classification record)

route_a_contraction_test.status: ROOT-DECLARED ONLY (config field route_a_contraction_test; null = not declared). Without a declaration R10 is NUMERICS_LIMITED.

parameters.judgment_call: bool (root states whether a MODEL_INVALID from this test counts as a judgment call for D5)

LAST_RATIOS_AT_LEAST.evaluation: ratios q_i = r_i / r_(i-1) of the gas Fourier residual over the completed iterations 0..max_iterations-1 (all present, contiguous, bound to the checkpoint identity); NON_CONTRACTING iff the last n_last ratios are all >= threshold -> MODEL_INVALID ROUTE_A_NON_CONTRACTING_WITHIN_MAX_ITERATIONS; otherwise CONTRACTING -> NUMERICS_LIMITED ROUTE_A_ITERATION_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED_CONTRACTING. The residual history, the ratios and the verdict are recorded in the classification detail (bound into the cache entry and re-derived on every open).
